title: Pumping Station Telemetry Controller and Monitoring Dashboard for 18 Stations
executive_summary:
Thank you for your RFQ JQWS/TLM/2026/003 dated 12 January 2026. Rax Tech International is pleased to submit our technical and commercial proposal for a purpose-built telemetry controller and monitoring dashboard for 18 water pumping stations of Jebel Qara Water Services SAOC in the Dhofar region.

The requirement cannot be met by an off-the-shelf unit: the stations need a controller that reads pump, level and pressure signals, speaks Modbus to existing VFDs, survives 55 °C enclosure temperatures and reports over 4G with local buffering. We propose to engineer this controller in-house at our Chennai facility, building on the proven Rax embedded platform, together with a dashboard and alarm management service tailored to your operating procedures. Rax water quality sensors and Industrial Edge IoT Gateways are included where they fit the specification.

The work is delivered in four phases over 26 weeks, including prototype, field trial at two stations and factory acceptance testing before shipment. As a single point of accountability, Rax delivers hardware, firmware, cloud and integration with single-window support. Total project value is ₹45,84,026, with GST not applicable on export. This offer is valid for 90 days.
requirement_understanding: Telemetry at 18 pumping stations: pump run and trip status, motor current, tank level, discharge pressure and flow.
Operation in ambient temperatures up to 55 °C inside the control kiosk, with IP65 field enclosures.
Modbus RTU and TCP communication to existing variable frequency drives and flow meters.
4G reporting with at least 72 hours of local buffering and automatic back-fill on reconnection.
Dashboard with alarm management, trends, shift reports and role-based access, hosted on the client's cloud tenancy.
Integration of alarms with the utility's central SCADA over OPC UA.
Water quality (residual chlorine and turbidity) monitoring at six selected stations.
solution_overview:
The solution has three engineered parts. The Rax-designed telemetry controller (CUS-TLM-RTU) is a DIN-rail unit with isolated analog and digital I/O, two RS-485 ports, 4G with dual SIM and an industrial-temperature design verified in our environmental chamber. It is housed in a stainless IP66 enclosure with surge protection and a local operator display.

Four large stations also receive a Rax Industrial Edge IoT Gateway to aggregate multiple pumps and run local logic, and six stations receive Rax Water Quality Sensors. The telemetry dashboard is engineered by our software team on the client's cloud tenancy and exposes an OPC UA server for the central SCADA. All custom work is designed, built and tested in-house at our Chennai facility, with a factory acceptance test performed in the presence of the client's engineers before shipment.
